messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Synthetic canary 'deploy-ux-check-eu' failing 8 times in last 10m. Threshold breached. Severity: P2. Auto-page triggered. PagerDuty incident PD-2026-EO triggered. 

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered -> PD-2026-EO | Service: synthetic-canaries | Escalation policy: oncall-eu | Incident URL: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-2026-EO

maya (oncall): ack'd. taking this — starting triage. 

ana??? (typo removed)

lee (eng-sre): @maya can you paste the canary output? Is it 5xx spikes or timeouts?

maya (oncall): paste from canary logs (last 5 lines):
```
2026-03-14T10:12:01Z probe: status=504 target=/v1/generate latency_ms=3002
2026-03-14T10:13:01Z probe: status=200 target=/v1/health latency_ms=45
2026-03-14T10:14:01Z probe: status=502 target=/v1/generate latency_ms=2899
2026-03-14T10:15:01Z probe: status=524 target=/v1/generate latency_ms=15000
2026-03-14T10:16:01Z probe: status=502 target=/v1/generate latency_ms=3100
```
looks like intermittent 5xx on /v1/generate from eu-hosts. probe interval 60s.

ana (support): we have 3 tickets in EU complaining about slow responses on chat feature in the last 12m. Not widespread but definitely correlated to 10:12-10:18 window. Ticket ids: TCK-4321, TCK-4324, TCK-4330.

lee (eng-sre): thanks. @tom can you check lb metrics? Any backend pool health swings?

tom (infra): looking at infra dashboard — backend pool eu-gpu-1 shows transient connections reset spikes at 10:12-10:17, spike in 5xx rate to 0.22% overall for /v1/generate (baseline 0.01%). No CPU or mem OOM. Kernel logs show some TCP retransmit bursts from firewall appliance.

maya (oncall): ok so path looks like networking flaps causing retries/timeouts. PagerDuty, are we on primary escalation only? If this persists we should escalate to SEV oncall.

pagerduty: Current policy: oncall-eu acknowledged by maya. No escalation yet. Next escalation in 5m if not resolved or reassigned.

lee (eng-sre): two actions: 1) stop noisy paging by temporarily muting the canary rule or increase consecutive-failure threshold to avoid flapping, 2) mitigation for user impact — enable fallback routing to cached model variant for eu region. Thoughts?

maya (oncall): I'm going to mute the canary for 10m to prevent noisy pages while infra investigates. Marking action in incident timeline.

incident-bot: Action recorded: muted alert rule 'deploy-ux-check-eu' for 10m by maya (oncall).

tom (infra): I can push a quick iptables rule to drop offending flows from the firewall appliance to the unhealthy backend, or we can failover the load balancer to secondary path. I'd prefer failover to be safer. Starting failover to secondary LB now.

lee (eng-sre): notify if failover completes. Also, can we grab the probe runner container logs and restart it? Maybe its connection pooling is causing stale connections. Command: `kubectl -n probes logs deploy/ux-canary-runner --tail 200`

maya (oncall): ran the logs command; attaching relevant snippet: 
```
E Mar 14 10:12:00 connection=pool-4 error=write tcp 10.0.5.2:34567->52.14.33.2:443: write: connection reset by peer
W Mar 14 10:13:00 probe timeout exceeded for req 872
I Mar 14 10:15:00 restarting http client due to repeated errors
```
restarted the canary pod: `kubectl -n probes rollout restart deploy/ux-canary-runner` — pods restarted, new pod ready at 10:22.

tom (infra): LB failover completed at 10:21. Backend 5xx rate dropped to 0.03% by 10:23 — looks better.

ana (support): ticket owners updated: set expectation that team is investigating infra/networking; asked customers to watch for improvement.

lee (eng-sre): cool. I'm going to revert the recent probe config change we rolled out last night — we decreased `consecutive_failures_threshold` from 3 to 2 which made the canary more sensitive and noisy. Reverting now to reduce future noise and give infra time to stabilize.

maya (oncall): noted. Can you confirm revert applied?

lee (eng-sre): Revert applied at 10:25: `kubectl -n probes set env deploy/ux-canary-runner CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES=3` and restarted. Incident-bot: update check config to original.

incident-bot: Config change recorded: ux-canary-runner CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES set to 3 by lee (eng-sre).

maya (oncall): customer impact summary for PD page: limited impact in EU between 10:12-10:24. Rough numbers: ~0.2% 5xx for /v1/generate in EU (~250 failed requests in window), 3 support tickets, no major enterprise outages reported. Marking Severity: P2 (partial customer impact, recovery in progress).

lee (eng-sre): agree with P2. We'll continue monitoring for 1h. Tom, any follow-up ops actions?

tom (infra): I'll keep LB on failover for 30 more minutes, monitor firewall appliance for retransmit bursts and open a vendor ticket if patterns repeat.

maya (oncall): handoff: my shift ends in 40m. @lee please take oncall if this isn't fully stable by 11:00. I'll add notes to PD and incident timeline.

pagerduty: PD-2026-EO acknowledged by maya (oncall). Status: monitoring.

ana (support): I've updated all three tickets with mitigation steps and ETA for follow-up.

lee (eng-sre): will run a synthetic sweep now to validate. Running: `./scripts/run_synthetics --region eu --tests deploy-ux-check-eu --repeat 5`

incident-bot: Synthetic sweep started by lee (eng-sre). Results pending.

maya (oncall): thanks team. If things look stable in 15m I'll resolve the PD incident and reopen if it flares. Otherwise we'll escalate. Leaving notes for handoff.

lee (eng-sre): sweep results: 5/5 success within expected latency at 10:38. No additional 5xx observed. I'll own follow-up for the postmortem to look at firewall retransmits and whether canary sensitivity needs tuning.

maya (oncall): closing PD-2026-EO in 5m if no new pages. Good job. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-2026-EO: status changed -> monitoring by maya (oncall). Timeline saved.

lee (eng-sre): postmortem owners: lee (eng-sre), tom (infra). Will propose RCA and fixes (hardening LB failover, adjust canary threshold, vendor ticket for firewall) within 48h.

maya (oncall): handoff complete. I'm leaving notes and marking the incident as monitored.

ana (support): closing customer tickets as soon as we confirm 1h stable.

end of thread.
